briefdescription.para: Programs all bands of a field through the band engine.

parameterdescription.para: - Field whose bands are programmed in order.
- Caller source data words (validated by caller).
- Number of valid words in Data.

listitem.para: XST_SUCCESS on success.
XNVM_EFUSE_ERR_NTHG_TO_BE_PROGRAMMED is skipped per band (no bits to program in that band); other bands in the field still run.
Field/band error on failure.

briefdescription.para: Checks whether a program buffer contains any bits to blow.

parameterdescription.para: - Buffer produced by ComputeProgrammableBits().
- Number of valid words in Buf.

listitem.para: XST_SUCCESS when at least one word is non-zero.
XNVM_EFUSE_ERR_NTHG_TO_BE_PROGRAMMED when all words are zero.

briefdescription.para: Runs temperature and voltage checks before programming.

parameterdescription.para: - When TRUE, skip environmental monitoring.

listitem.para: XST_SUCCESS when checks pass or are disabled.
Environmental error OR'd with XNVM_EFUSE_ERR_BEFORE_PROGRAMMING on failure.

briefdescription.para: Checks caller data size against field MinSrcWords from the table.

parameterdescription.para: - Field descriptor with precomputed MinSrcWords.
- Caller source buffer (may be NULL when MinSrcWords is 0).
- Number of valid words in Data.

listitem.para: XST_SUCCESS when NumWords is sufficient.
XNVM_EFUSE_ERR_INVALID_PARAM on NULL data or short buffer.

briefdescription.para: Returns whether a protection trigger condition is satisfied.

parameterdescription.para: - Protection entry whose trigger is evaluated.

listitem.para: XST_SUCCESS when the trigger fired (protection should run).
XST_FAILURE when the trigger did not fire.
Other error (e.g. XNVM_EFUSE_ERR_CACHE_PARITY) on read failure. For RANGE_NONZERO, only XNvm_EfuseCheckZeros() returning XST_FAILURE (non-zero data) fires the trigger.

briefdescription.para: Maps cache-format DIRECT_WRITE data to fuse row LSB-first word(s).

parameterdescription.para: - Band geometry (ColStart..ColEnd).
- Request data in eFuse cache bit positions.

simplesect.para: Fuse row data for PgmAndVerifyData LSB-first column walk.

briefdescription.para: Opens the controller for programming (legacy order).

parameterdescription.para: - When TRUE, skip environmental monitoring.

listitem.para: XST_SUCCESS on success.
Environmental or setup error on failure.

simplesect.para: Legacy flow: environmental checks, then unlock/setup controller.

briefdescription.para: Closes the eFuse controller, preserving a prior error status.

parameterdescription.para: - Status accumulated before close; close errors are OR'd in only when Status is XST_SUCCESS.

simplesect.para: Combined status from programming and close steps.

memberdef.argsstring: (const XNvm_EfuseDevice *Dev, XNvm_EfuseFieldId FieldId, u32 EnvDisFlag, const u32 *Data, u32 NumWords)
memberdef.name: XNvm_EfuseEngineWriteField

briefdescription.para: Programs all bands of a field through the band engine.

parameterdescription.para: - Device table descriptor.
- Field to program.
- When TRUE, skip temperature/voltage checks.
- Source data words for the field bands.
- Number of valid words in Data.

listitem.para: XST_SUCCESS on success.
Field-specific before-program or write error on failure.

briefdescription.para: Programs protection bits when their trigger conditions match.

parameterdescription.para: - Device table descriptor.

listitem.para: XST_SUCCESS on success, including an explicit empty table (NO_PROTECTION flag with Protection == NULL and NumProtection == 0).
XNVM_EFUSE_ERR_INVALID_PARAM if Dev is NULL, the table pointer and count disagree, or the table is missing without NO_PROTECTION.
Protection-specific error on program failure.

briefdescription.para: Programs one band of a field through the controller.

parameterdescription.para: - Band descriptor to program.
- Caller source data words (required for COMPUTE_PRG and DIRECT_WRITE bands; may be NULL for FIXED_DATA bands).
- Number of valid u32 words at Data.

listitem.para: XST_SUCCESS on success or when the band has nothing to program.
XNVM_EFUSE_ERR_INVALID_PARAM on bad input or band flags.
Controller program error on failure.
